title: FurnishRoom Command
description: Furnish a room by its type, with rules not guesses: the same room gives the same layout. Bedroom: a bed (the largest that fits with 0.6 m beside it and at its foot) head to a solid wall away from the door, bedside tables, a wardrobe. Living: a sofa looking at the window, a coffee table, an armchair, a TV bench, a bookshelf. Dining: a table with a chair at every seat and room to pull them out. Kitchen: a run of fridge, sink, dishwasher and hob on the 600 module along a wall without a door, wall units over the base units, a table when the floor allows. Bathroom: shower or bath, WC with 0.2 m beside it, basin, washing machine. WC: WC and basin. Office: a desk with its end at the window and its chair, a shelf. Hall: shoe cabinet and coat rack. Laundry and storage: washing machine and shelves. Door swings and the floor in front of every piece stay clear; tall pieces keep off windows. Pieces already in the room stay, and a kind the room has is not added again; replace clears the room's furniture first and keeps pieces moved by hand. A room that cannot be furnished is refused with the reason.

room.description: The room's id, name or type, or all for every room of a type Forsk furnishes. Omit for the picked room, else the only one.

density.description: Free floor in front of pieces and the bed size it tries first. Default relaxed.

variant.description: consistent (default), or creative: the main piece takes the next-best wall.

replace.description: Clear the room's furniture first, except pieces moved by hand since Forsk placed them.

preview.description: Show both layouts as ghosts in the viewport (the usual in blue, the creative in orange) and place nothing; the window offers a card to place one.
